verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents management endpoints for creating and rotating API keys programmatically, and a community user confirms minting keys with per-key expiry and limits. Workspace budgets exist with daily, weekly, monthly or lifetime caps, but the evidence only shows them as a feature, not as something set through an admin API, and provisioning gateways or workspaces programmatically is not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: programmatic provisioning of workspaces/gateways, explicit API control of budgets, and in-depth admin API reference docs.
